title: Hydration-dependent proton transfer from hydronium to benzene
difficulty_reasons: Requires independent candidate complex and pathway generation for three hydration states.
Requires stationary-point validation and qualitative kinetic interpretation rather than a fixed direct calculation.

paper.title: Investigations on the field dependency of proton and charge transfer kinetics in atmospheric pressure corona discharge sources

data.description: Self-contained XYZ starting structures for benzene, hydronium, its mono- and dihydrates, protonated benzene, plus charge/multiplicity manifest.

required_deliverables.description: Validated computational results, candidate/pathway identities, comparisons, conclusion and limitations.
